name: sinh-ton-the-last-bell
description: Sinh Tồn 3D - Web Game Ma Sói Học Đường nhiều người chơi

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sinh-ton/shared && npm run build -w @sinh-ton/client && npm run build -w @sinh-ton/server
scripts.build:client: npm run build -w @sinh-ton/shared && npm run build -w @sinh-ton/client
